brief: Segment A, shared path. A tight corridor that opens into a shaft the player climbs to a door in the ceiling. The shaft is THREE standard floors tall (1200), so the whole room spans at least 1000 vertical — the room budget requires it. The climb crosses the room: send consecutive ledges to OPPOSITE sides of the shaft so no two share a column, and vary their widths. One Hunter grapple pocket on a perch OFF the route — higher than 250 above any route surface so base movement cannot reach it — with its anchor 150-200 above the perch. One Titan bash pocket, both locks visible from the route.

circuit_breaker.diagnosis: attempts 2 and 3 were both worse than attempt 1: 4 softlock(s) and 8 error(s) now, against 0 and 3 then (softlocks outrank other errors, since only they block the build). Fixing one rule is repeatedly breaking another.
circuit_breaker.human_action: Keep the best attempt, which is saved beside the report, and repair it by hand or re-brief with the two rules named together. Rules that cannot both be satisfied by moving the same geometry usually mean the room's dimensions are wrong, not its contents.
